name: motion-sticker-pack
title_zh: 静态图进、动图包出，中间不用你碰一次视频软件
tagline_zh: 给角色图或一句文字描述，自动定风格、排表情、生成静态稿，你点头后才动视频，最后自动拆帧打包成贴纸集。
tagline_en: Feed it a character image or text prompt; it locks style, lays out emoji reactions, renders a static sheet for.
desc_en: Create an animated sticker pack from a supplied character image or a text-defined character by collecting a style and Emoji or short reaction descriptions, generating and approving a static sheet, then routing video generation, cleanup, splitting, and packaging. Also process existing static sheets or grid videos. Use for animated emoji or sticker-pack production, not for designing a separate chara
why_zh: 把「生成静态稿→人工审→再动视频」这个最容易返工的环节做成硬门禁：没你确认，绝不浪费一次视频生成额度。
why_en: The killer is the approval gate: no video generation credit is spent until you sign off on the static sheet, killing the most.
limit_zh: 只做贴纸包流水线，不负责角色设计本身；输入得是单张角色图或清晰文字描述，已有网格图/视频可直接拆。
limit_en: Pipeline only for sticker packs, not character design. Needs one character image or clear text description. Won't inpaint missing frames or fix.
title_en: Static image in, animated sticker pack out, no video tools.
